[0.4.198] - Memory authority and diagnostics release candidate (2026-11-08)
  • Recommend CLI 0.166.145 and pair with VS Code/Open VSX 0.37.181 after verified Session Core 0.3.27 and CLI publication.
  • Include the read-only model-input diagnostics entry in the canonical public IDE capability contract and generated documentation.
  • Retain strict host matrices and upstream readback. Package publication does not grant native GUI, real-model or paid readiness.

[0.4.197] - goal transfer release candidate (2026-11-08)
  • Recommend CLI 0.166.144 and pair with the other IDE 0.37.180 after verified Session Core 0.3.27 and CLI publication.
  • Carry explicit goal transfer, signed rollback and the native canonical Graph host boundary through the matching CLI source.
  • Enable Windows Git long paths before CI checkout so immutable native acceptance artifacts do not prevent checks from starting.
  • Candidate only: exact-source release gates and public package readback remain required; no desktop installer or new business acceptance is claimed.

[0.4.196] - local compute and pending task creation (2026-11-06)
  • Recommend CLI 0.166.143; publish after verified Session Core 0.3.26 and CLI, pairing with the other IDE 0.37.179.
  • Add a distinct Local compute / OpenAI compatible option for LEXDATA, vLLM and SGLang, custom platform model IDs, optional platform keys, explicit HTTP consent and atomic CLI readback.
  • Keep relay protocol selection separate, never reuse an old endpoint key for a new keyless platform, and verify saved credentials only when required or explicitly supplied.
  • Add explicit task-creation request-file and v6 pending-draft controls for admitted scenario packages; matching desktop native consent and confirmation remain required.
  • Actual LEXDATA inference, real IDE GUI and business-effect assessment remain unverified; the supplied LEXDATA discovery connection was reset.

[0.4.195] - authorized goal events and retained history (2026-11-05)
  • Recommend CLI 0.166.142 and pair with Open VSX 0.37.178 after verified upstream publication.
  • Add explicit desktop event observation and retained-history recovery with native connection/checkpoint selection, bounded plain-text results, cancellation and host-bound next-page controls.
  • Use CLI exit zero plus protocol validation to confirm checkpoint commit; interruption retains an unknown checkpoint outcome.
  • Support the admitted project-delivery-assistant 0.2.0 scenario through existing evidence and pending-description controls. Native consent remains required.

[0.4.194] - complete source preview recovery pairing (2026-11-04)
  • Recommend CLI 0.166.141 and pair with Open VSX 0.37.177 after verified CLI publication.
  • Carry the shared runtime repair that preserves legitimate source spread expressions in file-read previews and keeps recovery instructions actionable.
  • Align the CLI and IDE entry boundaries in launcher-owned hermetic evaluations without changing ordinary interactive permissions or the IDE protocol.
  • Retain historical model results and finite diagnostic budgets. This release performs no additional paid model-task retests.
